missing_evidence: Order error stack traces or exception types to identify the failing code path
Order dependency call spans (payment, inventory, postgresql) to rule out downstream cause
candidates.statement: Order service is the fault locus: checkout spans error at 1350ms, order error_rate 0.16 with p95 440ms, and 7 unhandled_request_failure 500 logs, while gateway, payment and inventory remain healthy. This supports an order-side HTTP 500 failure driving the checkout alert.
candidates.uncertainty: Root mechanism inside order (code defect vs dependency) not established; deployment record alone cannot prove causation.

report.explanation: Current telemetry localizes errors to the order service: error-rate 0.16, p95 440ms, 7 HTTP 500 unhandled failures, and an errored checkout span. Gateway, payment and inventory metrics are healthy, and db_pool_waiters/dependency_timeouts are zero, so pool exhaustion, redis timeout and downstream latency are not supported. The specific order-side defect remains unproven.
